name: Getac F110-EX G6
statusNote: Getac now lists the G7 generation in its place; it published no end-of-sale date.
summary: The Getac F110-EX G6 is the hazardous-area version of a Getac rugged 11.6-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under IECEx. Getac also states ATEX certification, but the certificate isn't published. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Windows 11 Pro. It has been discontinued; the Getac F110-EX G7 replaces it.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx Current (both certificates), checked 2026-10-25; ATEX not published

iecex.marking: Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc

certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ic) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: Controlled environment with reduced pollution; protect from UV and mechanical impact; connection interfaces never used in hazardous areas; battery never changed, charged or removed in hazardous areas; not next to strong charge-generating processes; use only listed Li-ion batteries (BP3S1P2160-S or BP3S1P2290 A on the 2021 certificate; BP3S1P2680B or BP3S2P2100S-02 on the later one).
safety.peripherals: All connection interfaces (USB, Thunderbolt, DC-in, docking connector, LAN, serial) must never be used in hazardous areas (certificate condition). Optional internal modules named in the certificate are covered as part of the certified tablet.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Named in the certificate: shoulder strap, hand strap, 4-point shoulder harness, capacitive hard-tip stylus and tether, digitizer pen and tether. Hard handle (factory option) not named. AC adapter, chargers and batteries are not for hazardous areas.

os.name: Windows
os.updates: Windows 11: supported while kept on a current version (Microsoft Modern Lifecycle)

specs.chip: Intel Core i5-1135G7 / i5-1145G7 vPro / i7-1165G7 / i7-1185G7 (11th gen)
specs.frontCamera: 5 MP webcam, optional Windows Hello camera
specs.ports: Thunderbolt 4, USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A, DC-in, audio; optional barcode/USB/LAN/serial, HF RFID or fingerprint, smart card

unconfirmed.certification.atex.marking: Units built under Getac's earlier certificate are rated for dust group IIIB; later units are IIIC. Check the label on the device.
